description: Native reference 2026-09-19 scoped reference and declared-unit controls. Each case has three semantic children. Matching means the authored layout generated a/ b shapes; mismatching reference descriptors caused the native reference application to substitute its default layout, not a zero reference value. Unit cases use text algorithms so font constraints are available. Inputs retain authored literals; heights come from the saved native drawing in millimetres.

references.constraints: <dgm:constr type="h" for="ch" forName="a" ptType="all" val="20"/><dgm:constr type="h" for="ch" forName="b" refType="h" refFor="ch" refForName="a" refPtType="all" fact="0.5"/>
